build-bot: Push to GCR failed for image redwood/service-a:stable-20260310 — manifest digest mismatch on push, retrying.
maria-ng: Canary is showing 502s and the image pull digest doesn't match the one in the deployment. Anyone else seeing this?
jonathan: Yup, seen it. Buildkite logs show `push` returned OK, then later GCR responded `MANIFEST_INVALID: manifest invalid` during replication.
kevin-s: Looks like the pipeline re-pushed a new manifest with the same tag while replication was in-flight. Tag reuse bug.
maria-ng: Ugh. Do we have cosign signatures for the image? If signed, we can verify provenance before rolling.
tara: We sign prod images, but this particular job timed out on the signing step so the signed artifact wasn't uploaded.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused at 40% due to image mismatch. Options: rollback to pinned digest or force a full rebuild+resign. @jonathan can you pin?
jonathan: I'll pin to the last-known-good digest and update the deployment to use the immutable reference.
jonathan: kubectl patch deploy service-a -n prod -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"service-a","image":"gcr.io/redwood-prod/service-a@sha256:abcdef1234567890"}]}}}}'
maria-ng: Good call. Also we should prevent tag reuse in GCR for prod (set immutability) and add a guard in the pipeline to fail if signing didn't complete.
kevin-s: I'll open a short-lived GCR policy change to make tags immutable for prod projects and add retry logic on signing step.
build-bot: Rebuild queued: #4721. Signing step now runs with extended timeout and cosign upload enabled.
tara: We'll also add a verification step in the deploy job: fetch remote digest and compare to expected before swapping traffic.
maria-ng: Filing a ticket for the pipeline check and adding logs: INFRA-839 — includes Buildkite job id 4720 and GCR error traces.
deploy-bot: Rollback applied to sha256:abcdef1234567890. Canary resumed at 10%.
kevin-s: Monitoring metrics. If error rate stays <0.5% for 15m, we'll continue rollout.
sre-bot: Alert cleared at 1769810845 :white_check_mark:.
maria-ng: Follow-up list: 1) pin immediate prod tag immutability, 2) pipeline signing + retry, 3) deploy-time digest check, 4) postmortem and runbook update. Thanks all :thumbsup:
